newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takara Shuzo falls on WTO ruling reports.
newsitem.headline: Takara Shuzo falls on WTO ruling reports.

text.p: Shares in Takara Shuzo Co Ltd fell in mid-afternoon trade on Thursday, depressed by media reports that the World Trade Organisation (WTO) had ruled in a final report that Japan's liquor taxation system runs counter to WTO rules, brokers said.
The shares were down 40 yen at 1,080 yen at 0505 GMT in turnover of 1.735 million shares.

Media reports said details of the ruling have not been released yet, but they said the WTO has already notified the parties involved of its recommendation and will do the same for WTO members on Friday.
Separately, Takara said earlier that it would stop selling some of its grape juice products due to defects, and also recall 110,000 cases of grape juice already on the market.
Brokers said if the news was only about the grape juice, the share price would not be harmed much.
"If the ruling turns out to be a fact, it could provide downward pressure on companies' earnings and that is prompting selling," one broker said.
